# Pixel Task List

An offline, pixel-style task list built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

## Features

- Add tasks with the input (`#todo-input`) and Add button (`#todo-add`).
- Blank or whitespace-only input is ignored; text is trimmed.
- Live total task count (`#todo-total`) and incomplete count (`#remaining`), both start at 0.
- Each task shows a checkbox and delete button with IDs based on its numeric ID (e.g., `#todo-text-1`, `#todo-check-1`, `#todo-delete-1`).
- Toggling a checkbox updates the incomplete count.
- Deleting a task removes it and updates both counts.
- New tasks receive increasing numeric IDs.
- All state is kept in memory; no storage or network requests.

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Accessibility

- All controls have visible labels or `aria-label` attributes.
- Buttons have hover, focus, and pressed states.
- Layout works from 360px width.

## Files

- `index.html` – structure
- `styles.css` – pixel theme and responsive layout
- `app.js` – task logic

## Design

Cohesive palette: dark blue background (#1a1a2e), card (#16213e), accent (#e94560), light text (#eee), muted (#aaa). System fonts at 18px base size. Pixel-like borders and shadows.
